chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But [He granted authority] over those who take him as their guardian and disobey His command.

key_terms.يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُمْ: Those who take him as guardian/ally

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Satan having authority over believers according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a) clarification that Satan’s *sultan* (authority/power) is not inherent but contingent upon human free will and voluntary submission, a key distinction in Shia theology against predestination. This hadith underscores that while Satan has dominion over those who heed him, the faithful who maintain *tawhid* and obedience to God remain immune to his absolute control, reinforcing the concept of *wilayah* as a shield against spiritual subjugation.
